description:
Say what is wrong with what a request produced, and have it reworked.

    Status must be "done". `feedback_md` is 1..2000 chars. Moves the thread to
    refine_pending; poll get_request_status to see the revised items. Refinement
    re-plans the thread's roadmap items and can EDIT OR HARD-DELETE the task rows
    it generated earlier (the machine patch-tasks endpoint deletes them
    outright), so treat this as destructive: up to five refinements per thread
    each carry that power.
name: refine_request
